name: Pabrinex (Multivitamin infusion)
dosing: Per local protocol (e.g., parenteral B vitamins in alcohol withdrawal/malnutrition)
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to any component of the preparation
monitoring: Observe for immediate hypersensitivity during and after infusion; monitor clinical response (neurological improvement in Wernicke's) and fluid balance in large-volume infusions
pregnancy: Use if indicated; parenteral thiamine is safe when clinically required
sideEffects: Very rare allergic reactions or anaphylaxis; local infusion-site reactions may occur
clinicalPearls: Essential to give parenteral thiamine promptly in suspected Wernicke's encephalopathy or severe malnutrition; follow local protocols for dose and infusion rates
indication: Replacement of thiamine and other B vitamins in severe deficiency states such as Wernicke's encephalopathy and in malnourished patients
